rationale: The Evaluator feedback indicates that the last candidate has not yet been raced, so we lack telemetry data to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The feedback suggests improving stability and reducing aggressive driving by slightly lowering base_speed to 1.4, increasing kd to 3.5 to enhance damping, and adjusting sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0] to increase the influence of the inner sensors for better steering precision. I have implemented these changes accordingly, keeping kp at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain a balance between responsiveness and integral correction. The geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. I expect these adjustments to improve stability, reduce oscillations and line loss events, and maintain good speed. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects after racing.
